description: This file is a shell script that controls DHCP server and DNS services on a device. It includes functions for starting, stopping, and restarting dnsmasq, handling lan status changes, and managing DHCP leases and configurations. It also processes various events related to DHCP and DNS, such as configuration changes, starting/stopping services, and handling leases.

methods.name: is_device_extender
methods.description: Determines whether the device operates as an extender by checking the device mode configuration.

methods.name: is_mesh_ready
methods.description: Checks if the mesh network link status is up, indicating mesh readiness.

methods.name: dnsserver_start_lxc
methods.description: Starts the dnsmasq service inside an LXC container if relevant containers are active.

methods.name: dnsmasq_server_start
methods.description: Starts the dnsmasq server with appropriate options based on configuration and system state.

methods.name: lan_status_change
methods.description: Handles changes in LAN status, initiating or stopping DHCP and DNS services accordingly.

methods.name: restart_request
methods.description: Handles restart requests for DHCP/DNS services, reloading configurations if needed.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes service variables by retrieving configuration parameters.

methods.name: resync_to_nonvol
methods.description: Resynchronizes DHCP pool configurations with persistent storage.

methods.name: dhcp_server_start
methods.description: Starts the DHCP server and associated services, configuring dnsmasq accordingly.

methods.name: dhcp_server_stop
methods.description: Stops the DHCP server and associated services, cleaning up processes and configurations.

methods.name: dns_start
methods.description: Starts the DNS service (dnsmasq) with current configurations.
